title: Scheduling LLM Inference with Uncertainty-Aware Output Length Predictions
technique: Tail Inflated Expectation metric for SJF under log-t output-length distribution

optimized_metrics.evidence: TIE reduces the per-token latency by $2.31\times$ for online inference

extractor_notes: Abstract-only extraction. "per-token latency" in an SJF/online-queueing context most likely means request latency normalized by output length (NORM_LAT), but abstract does not define it; could be TPOT.
